facts: About 6,320 people (2017 census), roughly 60% of the nation
A narrow ring of land, 20 to 400 m wide, around a lagoon 18 km long
worth_knowing: An American sea captain named it Ellice's Island in 1819, after an English politician. In World War II the Americans dredged its lagoon harbour and built the airfield.
